_comment: Project Architect 3.0 — PROJECT-level settings snippet (<repo>/.claude/settings.json, committed). Merged by pa_install.py --project (step P7) after backing the file up. {{PY}} is filled at copy time with the project interpreter (python on Windows, python3 on WSL) — the same value as pa.json.python. NO hooks: every PA3 hook is user-level, installed once per config dir by pa_install.py --root. A pre-existing project hook that is not PA2's SessionEnd backup (bfm's Ghidra MCP start/stop) is left alone; the PA2 SessionEnd backup hook is removed, its job having moved to session_end.py. .claude/settings.local.json is never touched, except autoMemoryDirectory when the memory migration needs it.
_merge_rules: add-if-absent for every key EXCEPT: todoFeatureEnabled — forced to false (announced override; removes the Task tools); permissions.allow and permissions.deny — union with what is already there, order preserved, no duplicates, an existing allow entry never removed; env — add-if-absent per variable; model and modelSettings — add-if-absent here and only here (the pa-session's pinned model and effort land once on a fresh install; a hand-edited value is never overwritten; the user-level merge never touches them); an old shipped default (model claude-sonnet-5[1m], modelSettings.claude-sonnet-5 = {effortLevel: medium}, exactly) migrates to claude-sonnet-5-5 on every --project run, a pa3 upgrade included, any other value kept (3.12 T1). Validate the merged JSON parses before writing; on any failure restore the .bak.
